activity_summary: You were not dressed for the afternoon. You told the house that Titus goes on without you, and that you go at five. Alse set dinner as if you were staying. Mistress Ansell kept the pot ordinary, and kept noon as hers. You had pages to read, and they were not the play the house was giving.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was not in Titus, and that he would keep noon.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the pot ordinary and the noon hers.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set dinner for a man who was staying.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Mentioned in Not dressed for it

facets.activity: Stayed home while Titus went on

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The house plays Titus. I am not in it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Five is your affair. Noon is mine.
